phase_name: App/Tests Implementation Start Go/No-Go Final Judgment Template Design
phase_japanese_name: app/tests 実装開始可否の最終NO-GO/GO判定テンプレート
purpose: Design the final GO/NO-GO judgment template for app and tests implementation start authorization, to be filled only after actual Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement results are obtained, Phase 19-7/19-8 processes are executed against real data, and Phase 20-2 safety gate is CLEARED

important_interpretation_note.note: This document is a DESIGN TEMPLATE for the final GO/NO-GO judgment. It does NOT authorize implementation. It defines what fields must be filled and what conditions must be true for implementation to be authorized. At the time of this design, all conditions are NOT_MET and implementation remains NO_GO.

scope_1_final_judgment_template.description: Template for the final GO/NO-GO judgment document, to be filled with actual measurement results

section_1_actual_measurement_results.description: Fill with actual values from completed Phase 19-7/19-8 process applied to real measurements

integrated_decision_actual.source: Phase 19-1 execution record section_4, confirmed by Phase 19-7 check A5

receiver_validator_permission_actual.source: Phase 19-2 execution record section_4, confirmed by Phase 19-7 check A6

section_2_gate_condition_evaluation.description: Evaluate all gate conditions against actual measurement values

gate_1_integrated_decision_go.note: NOT_MET if NO_GO; implementation cannot proceed

gate_2_receiver_validator_effective.note: NOT_MET if NOT_EFFECTIVE; implementation cannot proceed

gate_3_dual_gate_unlocked.note: DUAL_GATE_LOCKED means implementation cannot proceed regardless of individual values

gate_4_safety_gate_cleared.note: Safety gate must be cleared before this judgment is valid

gate_5_human_authority_final_approval.condition: Authorized human explicitly approves implementation start in this judgment document

approval_record.approval_statement: I confirm that all gate conditions are MET and authorize app/tests implementation start

section_3_final_go_no_go_determination.description: Final GO/NO-GO determination based on all gate conditions

determination_logic.GO_condition: ALL of: gate_1=MET AND gate_2=MET AND gate_3=MET AND gate_4=MET AND gate_5=MET
determination_logic.NO_GO_condition: ANY of: gate_1=NOT_MET OR gate_2=NOT_MET OR gate_3=NOT_MET OR gate_4=NOT_MET OR gate_5=NOT_MET

final_determination.determination_basis: All 5 gates MET / Gate(s) X not met

implementation_scope_if_go.authorized_scope: generic_block_ai/app/ and generic_block_ai/tests/ per design specifications
implementation_constraints: Follow design artifacts from Phases 1 through 19
No production execution without additional authorization
All changes must be tracked via git
Test suite must pass before any production consideration

remediation_by_gate.gate_3_not_met: Re-examine Phase 19-3 cross-validation; resolve inconsistencies or re-execute measurements
remediation_by_gate.gate_4_not_met: Return to Phase 20-2; resolve safety gate blocking conditions
remediation_by_gate.gate_5_not_met: Obtain explicit human authority approval before re-issuing this judgment

scope_2_current_state_snapshot.description: Snapshot of current state at time of this design (NOT a filled judgment; all gates NOT_MET)

snapshot_as_of_design.dual_gate_final_status_actual: DUAL_GATE_LOCKED (by definition while measurements are not executed)
snapshot_as_of_design.gate_4_met: NOT_EVALUABLE (Phase 20-2 not yet run against actual data)

scope_3_activation_conditions.description: Conditions under which this template is activated and filled with real data
activation_sequence: 1. Actual Phase 15-7 measurement executed with human authorization
2. Phase 19-1 execution record filled with actual results
3. Phase 19-4 format validation run on filled Phase 19-1 record
4. Phase 19-5 evidence locking of filled Phase 19-1 record
5. Actual Phase 15-8 measurement executed (only if Phase 15-7 result = GO)
6. Phase 19-2 execution record filled with actual results
7. Phase 19-4 format validation run on filled Phase 19-2 record
8. Phase 19-5 evidence locking of filled Phase 19-2 record
9. Phase 19-3 cross-validation executed against both actual records
11. Phase 19-7 final verification report generated from actual records
12. Phase 19-8 dual-gate unlock judgment generated from actual records
13. Phase 20-1 receipt confirmation run against actual Phase 19 outputs
15. If Phase 20-2 SAFETY_GATE_CLEARED: fill this template (Phase 20-3) with actual values
17. If all 5 gates MET: final_determination = GO; implementation authorized

phase_20_3_completion_criteria: 5 gate conditions defined (integrated_decision GO, receiver_validator EFFECTIVE, dual-gate unlocked, safety gate cleared, human approval)
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
